title: treaty URL shape
description: The shape of a URL one product builds and another opens: the origins it may have, its exact path, and its query and fragment parameters, each with a JSON Schema for its decoded value. A URL is read as the WHATWG URL standard reads it; parameters are decoded as application/x-www-form-urlencoded. A parameter the shape does not name is ignored, a named one may appear at most once, and a URL with a user name or password is refused. Shapes live at schemas/urls/<name>.v<N>.json, their cases (valid: label → URL, invalid: { why, body: URL }) at fixtures/urls/<name>.v<N>.cases.json.

origins.description: The origins the URL may have; it matches when one of them matches.

scheme.description: The scheme, lower case, without its colon.

hosts.description: The only host names allowed with this scheme (without a port). Absent: any host.

path.description: The URL's path exactly as the WHATWG URL standard reports it (`pathname`): `/link/matrix`, or empty for `app://host?x=1`.

schema.description: The JSON Schema the decoded value (a string) satisfies.
